name: AmberX to-dos help
description: Help mode entries for the AmberX to-dos plugin (help@1): the page, its controls and its settings tab.
author: Brett

entries.title: AmberX to-dos
entries.text: Every AmberX to-do and task on every device. Today shows what is due today (and overdue, unless switched off); Upcoming the next seven days. Tick a box to finish one; the arrows change the order. Claude reaches the same to-dos with amberx-tasks_* and amberx_*, the CLI with axf todo.

entries.title: New to-do
entries.text: Type it, pick a due day if it has one, Add. It goes to the list picked above, or to the default list in settings.

entries.title: To-dos
entries.text: The to-dos and tasks on this tab. Delete asks first and can't be undone.

entries.title: AmberX to-dos settings
entries.text: Which tab opens first, where new to-dos go, to-do or task by default, how many show, and whether overdue ones show under Today. Kept on the console: axf amberx-tasks set-settings changes them too.

entries.title: Open a tab or a to-do
entries.text: Opens the to-dos page on a tab (today, upcoming, todo, all, done), one to-do (item:<id>) or the new to-do field (new).
